panels.title: MCU health
panels.description: Non-zero: power fault, temperature or voltage alarm active now (see HEALTH_* bits).

panels.title: Power state
panels.description: POWER_FAILURE is red.

panels.title: Previous boot ended in
panels.description: Newest fatal error-log entry of the previous boot. Suspect if RESET_CAUSE is not SW.

panels.title: Power failures in range
panels.description: Increase of the PWR_* failure counters over the time range.

panels.title: I2C master errors in range
panels.description: Failed transfer starts and non-NACK errors per bus (NACKs are not counted).

panels.title: Min free stack (words)
panels.description: Lowest stack high-water mark over all tasks. Thresholds are a suggestion.

panels.title: MCU uptime
panels.description: Drops to 0 at a reset; all counters restart then.

panels.title: I2C slave (IPMC) events in range
panels.description: Duplicate DATA interrupts and unhandled I2CSCSR values.

panels.title: I2C slave timeouts in range
panels.description: Also counts harmless lone 1-byte writes, so only a fast rise matters.

panels.title: LGA80D bad temperature reads in range
panels.description: READ_TEMPERATURE_1 (BADT1) / _3 (BADT3) words outside 0..175 C; FFFF = the -0.50 C glitch.

panels.title: Diag schema
panels.description: This dashboard was built for DIAG_SCHEMA 8.

panels.title: Power state
panels.description: PWR_FAIL_STEP 0 means no failure since boot.

panels.title: Supply masks
panels.description: One bit per supply (PS_OKS order). FAILED_MASK says which supplies failed.

panels.title: Snapshot generation
panels.description: Increments by 2 per power snapshot change.

panels.title: Previous boot fatal entry
panels.description: Error-log entry: code (7 hard fault, 8 assert, 9 stack overflow, 21 malloc) and data.

panels.title: Assert PC
panels.description: Decode with arm-none-eabi-addr2line -e cm_mcu.axf <PC> for the matching build.

panels.title: I2C slave registers
panels.description: SNAP_* describe the first duplicate interrupt (meaningful once DUP_IRQ > 0).

panels.title: TEMP1: latest bad word
panels.description: 0 until this sensor's first bad read.

panels.title: TEMP3: latest bad word
panels.description: 0 until this sensor's first bad read.

panels.title: LGA80D STATUS_WORD
panels.description: 0x0840 = output off (OFF + PGOOD#); 0xFFFF = no data (NO_DATA bit).

panels.title: Free stack per task (words)
panels.description: High-water mark: only goes down within a boot. 65535 (task not created) is hidden.
